dedupe_keys.name: german air transport performance statistics open standard data sets flight stage and ofod data

description: The German statistical offices publish the standard data sets of the air transport performance statistics (Verkehrsleistungsstatistik im Luftverkehr) as open data. The statistics cover commercial air transport at the main airports with more than 150,000 passenger units a year, for German and foreign airlines, and record flights with the passengers, freight and mail carried. Two data sets are offered: flight-stage data (departure and landing airports, passengers, freight and mail by aircraft type) and OFOD data (the route origin, route destination and final destination airports of arriving and departing passengers). The statistics are monthly and the data sets are released once a year, each holding the monthly results of that year; the current files hold monthly data for 2011 to 2025 as zipped CSV (about 92 MB and 27 MB), with a data set description for each, and are free to download under the Data Licence Germany 2.0 (Datenlizenz Deutschland 2.0), which requires attribution. The page was updated on 30 January 2026. Coverage is national, airport by airport. Caveats: small airports are excluded, and the files come a year behind. The data give airport-pair demand and freight flows for air network flow and capacity models and sit beside the Dutch and Brazilian airport statistics catalogued here.
name: German air transport performance statistics - open standard data sets (flight stage and OFOD data)
